availability.note: No UK licensed-medicine information for polyvinyl alcohol + povidone eye drops. Searched 2026-10-17: emc by ingredient (polyvinyl alcohol, povidone) and by the clinic trade name (no matching product; povidone results are povidone-iodine only); MHRA Products SPC/PIL index by product name and active substance (no document lists polyvinyl alcohol or povidone as an active substance). Both emc links in the clinic monograph (products 1638 and 3537) are hypromellose eye drops, a different active substance, so they were not used. Lubricant eye drops of this type may be marketed in the UK as medical devices, which have no SmPC; this was not confirmed from a UK source. Not filled from non-UK or device information.
